Hi Team,
When we arrived to start the first shift, the caramel pump going to the Conbar was at 200 psi and shutting down.

Together with Maintenance, we performed troubleshooting tests and determined that the issue was caused by a blockage in the elbow located directly above the Conbar. The elbow was blocked with hardened caramel.

We cleaned the blockage, and the system is now ready to run.

Actions taken:

	1.	I lowered the hot-water temperature from 190°F to 175°F to help prevent the caramel from hardening during production pauses.
	2.	We will monitor the pressure after a pause to determine whether the pipe going to the Conbar is too small and may be contributing to the pressure increase.

Pictures are attached showing the condition we found and the changes made.
Justin Garner Katya Farnsworth
